title: Theme conformance: run the matrix against a rendered theme (Services first)
detail: LIVE-1998 shipped the ten checks as pure functions over data. This row collects the data: a Playwright spec (test/e2e/theme-conformance.spec.ts) that walks conformanceMatrix() against a themed site, measures block heights per type voice at 1440 and 390, toggles motion and reduced motion, hides each function in turn, resets, and times a dial change, then feeds every result to lib/theme/conformance.ts. It runs for each theme that declares dials in lib/themes/editor-schema2.json, Services first, and must be green on every theme PR. Needs the Services render (LIVE-1991 to 1993) and the renderer's root attributes.
